id: title:Gilbert09:promote google play console source to beta

review.posthog_relevance: Updates release status metadata for the Google Play Console warehouse source, potentially affecting release notes or status indicators.
review.reason: The change is a metadata-only update, changing the release status from ALPHA to BETA. No implementation or behavior change is present. This is a narrow, localized maintenance change.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact depends on how the release status metadata is consumed by release notes or status indicators, which is not demonstrated in this metadata-only hunk.

observations.limitations: Only metadata and release status changed; no implementation or behavior change.

observations.behavior: Release status metadata updated from ALPHA to BETA.
